# Declare Tracker

An issue tracker fast enough to triage a six-figure backlog: one flat
list, searched as you type, filtered, sorted, and grouped; issues open
in place for editing; create, bulk operations, and delete with undo; a
live statistics rail. Virtualization is one declaration,
`virtualize = true` on the row: the list windows, recycles, measures its
mixed-height rows, and holds its viewport steady because the runtime does
all of that; this source just declares rows over data.

The architecture, end to end:

- **One truth.** `issues` holds the records: the source they are fetched
  from, and the class that knows what an issue is (its statuses and
  priorities, what a save must also change). Every write is one of its
  verbs, and every derivation re-runs because it read the records.
- **Views are derivations.** `shown` — the projected dataset the list
  renders — derives from the truth plus the view facts (filters, query,
  sort, grouping). The rail's counts, the workload bars, and the
  closed-per-day chart are the dataset's own derived datasets: change
  the data and every number moves, because each one is a constraint over
  the same truth.
- **Search is one more filter on the projection**, never a scan of
  rendered rows. The query narrows the derived dataset exactly as a
  status chip does; Enter and the search field's arrows walk the
  narrowed rows, which materialize on arrival like any others.
- **Editing is a working copy.** An open issue edits a draft dataset
  bound with `<->`; Save commits the draft into the truth and closes,
  Cancel discards and closes — cancel is honest, and autosave is not
  pretended.
- **Selection holds records**, not indices: it survives sort flips,
  filter changes, and scrolling out of the window; regenerating the
  dataset is the only thing that clears it.

Scale: the shipped asset is 10,000 issues (~350 KB gzipped); the bar's
scale control regenerates 10K / 100K / 1M in memory from the same seeded
generator (tracker-data.ts). Every millisecond the rail reports is
measured here, not asserted.

use [ PersonIcon ]   // the menus name their icons in data

// the seeded generator and a few formatting helpers: functions of their
// arguments, outside the reactive system

script [ "tracker-data.ts" ]

schema Issue [ id: number, title: string, description: string,
    status: "open" | "in-progress" | "blocked" | "closed",
    priority: "P0" | "P1" | "P2" | "P3",
    labels[]: string, assignee?: string,
    created: number, updated: number, closedAt?: number, comments: number ]

// One line of the list: an issue, or the header of a status group in the
// grouped view (`kind = "hdr"`, its `count`, no issue fields).

schema Line [ id: number, status: string, kind?: "hdr", count?: number,
    title?: string, priority?: string, labels[]?: string, assignee?: string, updated?: number ]


// ── the issues ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
//
// The records, fetched once from issues.json, and everything that is true of
// them whoever is looking: the vocabulary (statuses, priorities, labels),
// the rail's summaries, and every write, each keeping `updated` and
// `closedAt` honest so no caller has to. Nothing here knows what the user is
// looking at: filters, selection and the editor's draft belong to the App.

class Issues extends DataSource [ url = "issues.json", auto = true, schema = [ issues[]: Issue ],

    // workflow order: the chips, the rail and the grouped list all follow it

    statuses: string[] = ["open", "in-progress", "blocked", "closed"],
    statusLabel(s: string) -> string {
        return s == "open" ? "Open" : s == "in-progress" ? "In Progress" : s == "blocked" ? "Blocked" : "Closed"
        },

    priorities: string[] = ["P0", "P1", "P2", "P3"],
    priorityName(p: string) -> string {
        return p == "P0" ? "Urgent" : p == "P1" ? "High" : p == "P2" ? "Medium" : "Low"
        },

    labelNames: string[] = { TRK_LABELS },

    all() -> Issue[] { return this.read(["issues"]) ?? [] },
    total: number = { this.all().length },

    // the people who actually hold work: the records decide who is listed

    assignees() -> array {
        return [...new Set(this.all().map((it) => it.assignee).filter((a) => a != null))].sort()
        },

    nextId() -> number { return this.all().reduce((m, it) => Math.max(m, it.id), 0) + 1 },

    // ── the summaries the rail draws, each re-derived when the records change

    byStatus: Dataset [ schema = [ rows[]: [ status: string, n: number ] ],
        contents = { { rows: classroot.statusCounts() } } ],
    statusCounts() -> array {
        const n = new Map()
        for (const it of this.all()) n.set(it.status, (n.get(it.status) ?? 0) + 1)
        return this.statuses.map((s) => ({ status: s, n: n.get(s) ?? 0 }))
        },

    closedByDay: Dataset [ schema = [ days[]: number, peak: number ], contents = { classroot.closedPerDay() } ],
    closedPerDay() -> object {
        const DAY = 86400000
        let maxU = 0
        const all = this.all()
        for (const it of all) if ((it.updated ?? 0) > maxU) maxU = it.updated
        const today = Math.floor(maxU / DAY)
        const days = new Array(14).fill(0)
        for (const it of all) {
            const c = it.closedAt
            if (c == null) continue
            const d = today - Math.floor(c / DAY)
            if (d >= 0 && d < 14) days[13 - d] = days[13 - d] + 1
            }
        return ({ days: days, peak: Math.max(1, ...days) })
        },

    // who holds the open work, busiest first, and the unassigned last (name "")

    workload: Dataset [ schema = [ rows[]: [ name: string, n: number, peak: number ] ],
        contents = { classroot.workloadOf() } ],
    workloadOf() -> object {
        const m = new Map()
        let un = 0
        for (const it of this.all()) {
            if (it.status == "closed") continue
            const a = it.assignee
            if (a == null) un = un + 1
            else m.set(a, (m.get(a) ?? 0) + 1)
            }
        const top = [...m.entries()].sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]).slice(0, 6)
        const peak = Math.max(1, un, ...top.map((e) => e[1]))
        // peak rides on each row (a row's cursor sees its own record, not
        // the root): the fact lands where the view reads it
        const rows = top.map((e) => ({ name: e[0], n: e[1], peak: peak }))
        return ({ rows: [...rows, ({ name: "", n: un, peak: peak })] })
        },

    // ── the writes

    replace(list: array) { this.set([], ({ issues: list })) },        // works before anything has loaded, too

    add(it: Issue) { this.insert(["issues"], 0, ({ ...it })) },     // newest first

    // an edited copy of a record comes back whole

    save(d: Issue) {
        const i = this.all().findIndex((it) => it.id == d.id)
        if (i < 0) return
        const was = this.all()[i].status
        this.set(["issues", i, "title"], d.title)
        this.set(["issues", i, "description"], d.description)
        this.set(["issues", i, "status"], d.status)
        this.set(["issues", i, "priority"], d.priority)
        this.set(["issues", i, "assignee"], d.assignee)
        this.set(["issues", i, "labels"], [...d.labels])
        this.stamp(i, d.status != was ? d.status : null)
        },

    // one field across many records; a label is added, not replaced

    setEach(ids: number[], field: string, v: object) {
        const all = this.all()
        for (const id of ids) {
            const i = all.findIndex((it) => it.id == id)
            if (i < 0) continue
            if (field == "label") {
                if (!all[i].labels.includes(v)) this.set(["issues", i, "labels"], [...all[i].labels, v])
                } else {
                this.set(["issues", i, field], v)
                }
            this.stamp(i, field == "status" ? v : null)
            }
        },

    // every write bumps `updated`; a status write also moves `closedAt`

    stamp(i: number, status: string?) {
        const up = this.all()[i].updated + 1
        this.set(["issues", i, "updated"], up)
        if (status != null) this.set(["issues", i, "closedAt"], status == "closed" ? up : null)
        },

    // removes the records and hands back what `restore` needs to put them back

    removeEach(ids: number[]) -> array {
        const all = this.all()
        const removed = ids.map((id) => ({ index: all.findIndex((it) => it.id == id), rec: all.find((it) => it.id == id) }))
            .filter((r) => r.index >= 0).sort((a, b) => b.index - a.index)
        for (const r of removed) this.removeAt(["issues"], r.index)
        return removed
        },

    restore(removed: array) {
        for (const r of [...removed].sort((a, b) => a.index - b.index))
            this.insert(["issues"], Math.min(r.index, this.all().length), r.rec)
        }
    ]


// the tracker's own tokens, provided over the house preset in either mode:
// one color per status and per priority, the destructive red, the brand
// gradient's far stop, the white cut into filled shapes, the inks of the
// bulk bar, which inverts to the tooltip surface, and the muted tones people
// and labels are colored by — each holds white initials in both themes

theme Tracker [
    statusOpen = #45A557, statusProgress = #4C6FE7, statusBlocked = #E5484D, statusClosed = #9A9DA5,
    prioHigh = #B88024, prioMedium = #7C8698, prioLow = #AAB4BE,
    danger = #E5484D, brandTeal = #37B6A9, onFill = #FFFFFF,
    bulkLine = #666B72, bulkHover = #3A4048, bulkDanger = #FF9D9D,
    hues = [#6C7BD9, #4FA3A5, #C97B63, #8E6BC1, #5B9E5E, #C06A8C, #557FB8, #B08A4F]
    ]


// ── small pieces: the tracker's icon vocabulary ───────────────────────────
//
// One glance, no reading: status is a ring (hollow = open, dotted =
// in progress, filled = blocked, checked = done), priority is a bar
// trio, a person is an avatar. Text codes ("P2", "in-progress") retreat
// to the places prose belongs — menus and the detail panel.

class StatusIcon [ width = 14, height = 14,
    s: string = "open",
    ring: View [ x = 0, y = 0, width = 14, height = 14, cornerRadius = 7,
        fill = { s == "blocked" || s == "closed" ? app.statusColor(classroot.s) : null },
        stroke = { stroke(1.5, app.statusColor(classroot.s)) } ],
    dot: View [ visible = { s == "in-progress" }, x = 4.5, y = 4.5, width = 5, height = 5, cornerRadius = 2.5,
        fill = { app.statusColor(classroot.s) } ],
    chk: CheckIcon [ visible = { s == "closed" }, x = 1.5, y = 1.5, iconSize = 11, weight = 1.9,
        ink = { provided("theme").onFill } ],
    bang: Text [ visible = { s == "blocked" }, x = 5.5, y = 1, fontSize = 9, fontWeight = bold, wrap = false,
        textColor = { provided("theme").onFill }, text = "!" ]
    ]


class PrioIcon [ width = 14, height = 12,
    p: string = "P3",
    tooltipLabel = { "Priority · " + p + " " + app.issues.priorityName(p) },
    lit: number = { p == "P0" || p == "P1" ? 3 : p == "P2" ? 2 : 1 },
    tone: number = { p == "P0" ? provided("theme").danger : 0 },
    b1: View [ x = 0, y = 7, width = 3, height = 5, cornerRadius = 1,
        fill = { classroot.tone != 0 ? classroot.tone : provided("theme").textMuted } ],
    b2: View [ x = 5, y = 4, width = 3, height = 8, cornerRadius = 1,
        fill = { classroot.lit >= 2 ? (classroot.tone != 0 ? classroot.tone : provided("theme").textMuted) : provided("theme").line } ],
    b3: View [ x = 10, y = 0, width = 3, height = 12, cornerRadius = 1,
        fill = { classroot.lit >= 3 ? (classroot.tone != 0 ? classroot.tone : provided("theme").textMuted) : provided("theme").line } ]
    ]


class Avatar [ width = 22, height = 22, cornerRadius = 11,
    name: string = "",
    capSize: number = 8.5,
    fill = { name == "" ? null : app.hueOf(name) },
    stroke = { name == "" ? stroke(1, provided("theme").line) : null },
    cap: TextLabel [ x = 0, textAlign = center, fontWeight = semibold, wrap = false,
        width = 100%,
        fontSize = { classroot.capSize },
        letterSpacing = 0.3,
        textColor = { classroot.name == "" ? provided("theme").textFaint : provided("theme").onFill },
        text = { classroot.name == "" ? "—" : trkInitials(classroot.name) } ]
    ]


// a label pill: a color-keyed dot and the name, outline-quiet

class Tag [ height = 18, cornerRadius = 9, padding = [0, 9, 0, 7],
    t: string = "",
    stroke = { stroke(1, provided("theme").line) },
    layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = x, spacing = 4 ],
    dot: View [ y = 6, width = 6, height = 6, cornerRadius = 3, fill = { app.hueOf(t) } ],
    cap: Text [ y = 2.5, fontSize = 10.5, wrap = false,
        textColor = { provided("theme").textMuted }, text = { t } ]
    ]


// a status filter chip: the status, its live count, and the on state —
// pressing toggles the filter (a Control: tab stop, Space/Enter, the ring)

class Chip extends Control [ height = 28, cornerRadius = 8, padding = [6, 12, 0, 12],
    value: string = "",
    count: number = -1,         // -1 hides the count
    on: boolean = false,
    fill = { on ? provided("theme").controlSelected : hovered ? provided("theme").control : null },

    // the tally is a sprung number — `Spring [ attribute = … ]` animates any
    // slot, data included, so a bulk move rolls the counts over instead of
    // snapping them. One declaration; no other wiring anywhere.

    anim: number = 0,
    Spring [ attribute = anim, to = { count < 0 ? 0 : count }, stiffness = 170, damping = 26 ],

    // the label and the count share a baseline; the dot sits on it at mid-x-height

    layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = x, spacing = 6, align = baseline ],
    dot: View [ baseline: number = 7,
        width = 6, height = 6, cornerRadius = 3, fill = { app.statusColor(value) }
        ],
    cap: Text [ fontSize = 12.5, wrap = false,
        fontWeight = { classroot.on ? "semibold" : "normal" },
        textColor = { classroot.on ? provided("theme").text : provided("theme").textMuted },
        text = { app.issues.statusLabel(classroot.value) } ],
    n: Text [ fontSize = 11, wrap = false, visible = { classroot.count >= 0 && !app.compact },
        textColor = { provided("theme").textFaint }, text = { "" + Math.round(classroot.anim) } ],
    press() { app.toggleFilter("status", value) }
    ]


// A list row is one of two things: an issue, or the header of a status
// group in the grouped view. Each is its own class over one base — what
// they share is TableRow's protocol, the height spring and the row fill;
// the list builds each record as the class its `kind` names.

class ListRow extends TableRow [
    exp: boolean = false,

    // Opening and closing an issue animates — the one deliberate act in the
    // list, and the motion is what says "this row became a pane" rather than
    // "the list jumped". `targetH` is the resting height; the Spring carries
    // the row to it, and its landing is when the open card is revealed —
    // the spring's own event, not a guess at its duration.
    //
    // A row revealed by scrolling does not animate, and nothing here has to
    // say so: a row showing a record it was not showing before takes its
    // geometry outright, so an open row scrolled out and back returns at its
    // open height, and a reused row never slides from another record's.

    targetH: number = 44,
    height = 44,
    Spring [ attribute = height, to = { targetH }, stiffness = 320, damping = 34,
        onStop() { if (classroot.exp) app.revealOpen() }
        ],

    fill = { selected ? provided("theme").controlSelected : hovered ? provided("theme").surface : null },
    stroke = { active && app.list.focusVisible ? stroke(1, provided("theme").accent) : null }
    ]


// the group header — a status, its count, and the chevron that collapses
// the group; a click collapses instead of selecting

class GroupRow extends ListRow [
    targetH = 42,
    fill = { provided("theme").background },

    hdrRow: View [ y = 12, height = 24, padding = [0, 0, 0, 23],
        layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = x, spacing = 8 ],

        // collapsed points right, open points down: the same chevron the rest
        // of the chrome discloses with (it centres itself)

        chev: ChevronIcon [ iconSize = 11, ink = { provided("theme").textFaint },
            dir = { app.isCollapsed(:status) ? "right" : "down" } ],
        d: StatusIcon [ y = 5, s = :status ],

        // the status and its count share a baseline

        title: View [ y = center,
            layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = x, spacing = 8, align = baseline ],
            cap: Text [ fontSize = 13, fontWeight = semibold, wrap = false,
                text = { app.issues.statusLabel(:status) } ],
            n: Roll [ fontSize = 11.5, textColor = { provided("theme").textFaint }, n = { :count ?? 0 } ]
            ]
        ],

    onClick() { if (!disabled) app.toggleGroup(:status) }
    ]


// the issue row — one calm line: icons carry status and priority, the
// title is the row's single strong element, everything else recedes to
// the right (labels, the avatar, the date). The row never mentions how
// many of it exist.

class IssueRow extends ListRow [
    exp = { :id == app.expandedId },
    targetH = { exp ? 356 : 44 },

    // the row's one line, the top 44px whatever height the row springs to:
    //
    //   status ring ▸ priority bars ▸ title … labels ▸ avatar ▸ date
    //
    // In the grouped view the line indents, so every status ring hangs on one
    // vertical line under its group's header.

    line: View [ width = 100%, height = 44,
        padding = { [0, 24, 0, app.groupBy == "status" ? 42 : 24] },
        layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = x, spacing = 12, align = center ],
        stat: StatusIcon [ s = :status ],
        prio: PrioIcon [ p = { :priority ?? "P3" } ],

        // the title takes the room the line leaves, and an over-long one ellipsizes

        title: Text [ flexes = true, fontSize = 13.5, wrap = false, maxLines = 1, text = { :title ?? "" } ],

        // labels, assignee and date, flush right

        meta: View [
            layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = x, spacing = 12, align = center ],

            // the first two labels ride inline; "+n" carries the rest, and the
            // editor shows them all

            tags: View [ visible = { !app.compact && (:labels ?? []).length > 0 },
                layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = x, spacing = 6, align = center ],
                Tag [ datapath = :labels[0:2][], t = :@ ],
                more: Text [ fontSize = 10.5, wrap = false, visible = { (:labels ?? []).length > 2 },
                    textColor = { provided("theme").textFaint },
                    text = { "+" + ((:labels ?? []).length - 2) } ]
                ],
            avatar: Avatar [ name = { :assignee ?? "" } ],
            when: Text [ fontSize = 11.5, wrap = false, textAlign = right, width = 40,
                textColor = { provided("theme").textFaint },
                text = { trkDate(:updated ?? 0) } ]
            ]
        ],

    // selection announces itself with the accent bar, not a heavy fill

    bar: View [ visible = { parent.selected && !parent.exp }, x = 0, y = 6, width = 3, cornerRadius = 1.5,
        height = { Math.min(parent.height, 44) - 12 },
        fill = { provided("theme").accent } ],

    // the open-in-place editor, below the row's own line while the height
    // spring makes room. It exists only on the open row: a hidden editor in
    // every row would be most of what the list builds.

    card: EditorCard [ exists = { classroot.exp }, x = 12, y = 48, clip = true,
        width = { parent.width - 24 },
        height = { Math.max(0, parent.height - 56) },
        fill = { provided("theme").surface }, cornerRadius = 10,
        stroke = { stroke(1, provided("theme").line) },
        shadow = { shadow(0, 4, 16, 0x00000018) } ],

    // An issue row keeps TableRow's selection protocol and adds the context
    // menu. Only its line toggles the editor: a press on the open card below
    // it is a press inside the editor.

    onClick(e: PointerEvent) {
        if (disabled || (exp && e.y >= 44)) return
        if (exp) { app.closeDetail(); return }
        super.onClick()
        app.openDetail()
        },

    onContextMenu(e: PointerEvent) { app.rowMenu(this, e) },
    onHold(e: PointerEvent) { app.rowMenu(this, e) }
    ]


// a person's avatar as a menu icon — created into the standard icon
// column (`iconKind`), so person rows keep the settled anatomy: check
// column, icon column, labels on one text edge

class PersonIcon extends Avatar [ width = 16, height = 16, cornerRadius = 8, capSize = 6.5,
    name = { :name ?? "" }
    ]


// a rolling number — the rail's working unit: a Spring on the value itself

class Roll extends Text [ wrap = false,
    n: number = 0,
    anim: number = 0,
    Spring [ attribute = anim, to = { n }, stiffness = 170, damping = 26 ],
    text = { Math.round(anim).toLocaleString() }
    ]


// one rail statistic: an icon, a name, a bar, a rolling count. The row is a
// filter too: pressing it toggles the filter it counts. The icon is handed in
// where the row is used, and lands in `lead`.

class RailStat extends Control [ width = 100%, height = 30, cornerRadius = 7, padding = [0, 4, 0, 0],
    defaultplacement = lead,
    facet: "status" | "assignee" = "status",
    value: string = "",
    cap: string = "",
    n: number = 0,
    peak: number = 1,
    tint: number = 0,
    on: boolean = false,
    fill = { on ? provided("theme").controlSelected : hovered ? provided("theme").control : null },

    // the name and the count share a baseline; the icon and the bar sit against it

    layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = x, spacing = 6, align = baseline ],
    lead: View [ width = 24, height = 30,
        baseline: number = 19
        ],
    name: Text [ width = 92, fontSize = 12.5, wrap = false, maxLines = 1,
        fontWeight = { classroot.on ? "semibold" : "normal" },
        textColor = { classroot.on ? provided("theme").text : provided("theme").textMuted },
        text = { classroot.cap } ],
    track: View [ flexes = true, height = 4, cornerRadius = 2,
        baseline: number = 6,
        fill = { provided("theme").control },
        fillbar: View [ height = 4, cornerRadius = 2,
            width = { Math.max(2, parent.width * classroot.n / Math.max(1, classroot.peak)) },
            fill = { classroot.tint != 0 ? classroot.tint : provided("theme").accent } ]
        ],
    num: Roll [ width = 44, fontSize = 12, textAlign = right,
        textColor = { provided("theme").textMuted },
        n = { classroot.n } ],
    press() { app.toggleFilter(facet, value) }
    ]


// a rail section's caption

class RailCaption extends Text [ fontSize = 11, fontWeight = semibold, letterSpacing = 0.6, wrap = false,
    textColor = { provided("theme").textFaint }
    ]


// one line of the rail's performance panel: what was measured, and how long it took

class PerfLine [ width = 100%, height = 16,
    what: string = "",
    ms: number = 0,
    a: Text [ fontSize = 11.5, wrap = false, textColor = { provided("theme").textMuted }, text = { classroot.what } ],
    b: Text [ x = end, fontSize = 11.5, wrap = false, text = { classroot.ms + " ms" } ]
    ]


// a button that opens a menu: a label and a chevron, with an optional color
// dot before them. `on` marks a filter that is set. The toolbar's filters and
// sort use it, and the editor's facets extend it.

class DropButton extends Control [ height = 28, cornerRadius = 8, padding = [0, 4, 0, 13],
    label: string = "",
    on: boolean = false,
    muted: boolean = true,              // the label recedes unless the filter is on
    tint: number = 0,                   // 0 = no dot
    fill = { on ? provided("theme").controlSelected : hovered || pressed ? provided("theme").control : null },
    layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = x, spacing = 8 ],     // the chevron centres itself
    dot: View [ visible = { classroot.tint != 0 }, y = 10, width = 8, height = 8, cornerRadius = 4, fill = { classroot.tint } ],
    t: Text [ y = center, fontSize = 12.5, wrap = false,
        fontWeight = { classroot.on ? "semibold" : "normal" },
        textColor = { classroot.on || !classroot.muted ? provided("theme").text : provided("theme").textMuted },
        text = { classroot.label } ],
    c: ChevronIcon [ iconSize = 11, ink = { provided("theme").textMuted } ]
    ]


// one line of the rail's keyboard legend: the key, and what it does

class KeyHint [ width = 100%, height = 18, padding = [1, 0, 0, 0],
    shortcut: string = "",
    what: string = "",
    layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = x, align = baseline ],
    k: Text [ width = 44, fontSize = 10.5, textColor = { provided("theme").textMuted }, text = { classroot.shortcut } ],
    v: Text [ fontSize = 11.5, wrap = false, textColor = { provided("theme").textFaint }, text = { classroot.what } ]
    ]


// the undo toast: one at a time, rises from the bottom, waits eight seconds,
// honors its word. A newer notice replaces the pending dismissal.

class Toast [ visible = { shown || lift > 0.02 }, height = 40, cornerRadius = 10,
    shown: boolean = false,
    msg: string = "",
    hideTimer: DelayHandle? = null,
    lift: number = 0,
    Spring [ attribute = lift, to = { shown ? 1 : 0 }, stiffness = 260, damping = 26 ],
    opacity = { lift },
    padding = [0, 20, 0, 16],
    layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = x, spacing = 10 ],
    fill = { provided("theme").tooltipFill },
    shadow = { shadow(0, 6, 24, 0x00000040) },
    cap: TextLabel [ fontSize = 12.5, wrap = false,
        textColor = { provided("theme").tooltipTextColor }, text = { msg } ],
    u: Control [ y = 7, height = 26, cornerRadius = 7, padding = [0, 9, 0, 9],
        fill = { hovered || pressed ? provided("theme").accent : null },

App [ fill = { provided("theme").background }, textColor = { provided("theme").text }, minWidth = 320, appName = "Declare Tracker",

    // ── the responsive facts ───────────────────────────────────────────────

    compact: boolean = { app.width < 640 },      // the bar: brand compacts, omnibox shrinks

    barH: number = 56,

    theme = { { ...(app.darkUI ? SanFranciscoDark : SanFrancisco), ...Tracker } },

    statusColor(s: string) -> number {

    //

    // generated batch; `adopt` is where a batch arrives, and it starts the user
    // over: nothing selected, nothing open.

    issues: Issues [ onLoad() { app.landed() }

    ready: boolean = { issues.loaded },

    // the two views reached from far away: the one line each that knows where it lives

    list: Table = { app.body.main.list },
    omni: TextInput = { app.bar.search.omni },

    adopt(list: array) {
        issues.replace(list)
        this.takeSelection(null)
        this.closeDetail()
        },

    // Generating a million issues holds the main thread for seconds. The
    // press returns at once, so its own settle shows the new choice, and the
    // work runs on the next frame.

    generating: boolean = false,

    regenerate(count: number) {
        if (generating) return
        generating = true
        afterDelay(0, () => {
            const t0 = trkNow()
            const list = trkGenerate(count)
            this.loadMs = Math.round(trkNow() - t0)
            this.adopt(list)
            this.timeIngest()
            this.generating = false
            })
        },

    // ── measurements: the rail's PERFORMANCE panel ─────────────────────────
    //
    // Each reads the clock in a handler and closes with afterSettle, so a
    // number covers what the user waits for: the change, and the settle that
    // shows it. Nothing that derives the list reads a clock.

    startedAt: number = 0,
    loadMs: number = 0,          // boot to the issues landing, or the generator's run
    ingestMs: number = 0,        // the settle that shows a new batch
    searchMs: number = 0,        // the settle that shows a search's matches

    onInit() { startedAt = trkNow() },

    landed() {
        loadMs = Math.round(trkNow() - startedAt)
        this.timeIngest()
        },

    timeIngest() {
        const t0 = trkNow()
        afterSettle(() => { app.ingestMs = Math.round(trkNow() - t0) })
        },

    // ── the view facts ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    sortOn: "updated" | "priority" | "title" = "updated",
    sortDir: "asc" | "desc" = "desc",
    groupBy: "none" | "status" = "none",
    fStatus: string = "",                        // "" = no filter
    fAssignee: string = "",
    fLabel: string = "",

    // A filter, sort, query or grouping change is a new arrangement, not an
    // edit to the old one, so the list starts it at the top. Every writer of
    // one of these gets that, and no writer has to remember to ask.

    trackChanges = ["fStatus", "fAssignee", "fLabel", "query", "sortOn", "sortDir", "groupBy"],

    onChange(e: ChangeEvent) { this.list.scrollTo(0) },

    // Is the keyboard owned by a text field? A bare-character shortcut must
    // never steal a keystroke from one: the search box, or the open editor.

    typing: boolean = { app.editing || app.omni.focused },

    clearAll() {
        fStatus = ""; fAssignee = ""; fLabel = ""; query = ""
        },

    toggleFilter(facet: "status" | "assignee" | "label", value: string) {
        if (facet == "status") fStatus = fStatus == value ? "" : value
        else if (facet == "assignee") fAssignee = fAssignee == value ? "" : value
        else if (facet == "label") fLabel = fLabel == value ? "" : value
        },

    setSort(field: "updated" | "priority" | "title") {
        if (sortOn != field) { sortOn = field; sortDir = field == "title" ? "asc" : "desc" }
        },

    toggleSortDir() {
        sortDir = sortDir == "desc" ? "asc" : "desc"
        },

    // collapsed groups: replaced whole on every toggle, so each reader (the
    // header chevrons, the projection) wakes on its own

    collapsed: string[] = [],
    isCollapsed(s: string) -> boolean { return collapsed.includes(s) },
    toggleGroup(s: string) {
        collapsed = collapsed.includes(s) ? collapsed.filter((x) => x != s) : [...collapsed, s]
        },

    // ── the projection: the one derived dataset the list renders ──────────
    //
    // filter → search → sort → (group). Group headers are lines too, with
    // `kind = "hdr"`. The arguments are the view facts, passed because that
    // reads well: the data is not among them, and the compiler follows the
    // call to `issues.all()`.

    shown: Dataset [ schema = [ rows[]: Line, total: number ],
        contents = { app.project(app.fStatus, app.fAssignee, app.fLabel, app.query, app.sortOn, app.sortDir, app.groupBy) } ],

    project(byStatus: string, byAssignee: string, byLabel: string, query: string, sortOn: string, sortDir: string, grouping: string) -> object {
        let rows = this.issues.all()
        if (byStatus != "" || byAssignee != "" || byLabel != "") {
            rows = rows.filter((it) =>
                (byStatus == "" || it.status == byStatus) &&
                (byAssignee == "" || it.assignee == byAssignee) &&
                (byLabel == "" || (it.labels ?? []).includes(byLabel)))
            }
        // the query narrows like any other filter: a tracker searches by
        // hiding what doesn't match, not by bolding what does
        if (query.trim() != "") {
            const needle = query.trim().toLowerCase()
            rows = rows.filter((it) => trkHaystack(it).includes(needle))
            }
        // Every comparator is ascending, least interesting first: oldest,
        // lowest priority, A→Z. `desc` then reverses, uniformly, so a new sort
        // field inherits the rule.
        const urgency = (p) => -this.issues.priorities.indexOf(p)
        const asc = sortOn == "priority" ? (a, b) => urgency(a.priority) - urgency(b.priority) || a.updated - b.updated
            : sortOn == "title" ? (a, b) => (a.title < b.title ? -1 : a.title > b.title ? 1 : 0)
            : (a, b) => a.updated - b.updated
        rows = [...rows].sort(sortDir == "desc" ? (a, b) => asc(b, a) : asc)
        if (grouping != "status") return ({ rows: rows, total: rows.length })
        const out = []
        this.issues.statuses.forEach((st, i) => {
            const members = rows.filter((it) => it.status == st)
            if (members.length == 0) return
            out.push(({ kind: "hdr", id: -1 - i, status: st, count: members.length }))    // ids below every issue's
            if (!this.isCollapsed(st)) out.push(...members)
            })
        return ({ rows: out, total: rows.length })
        },

    //
    // The query narrows the list; Enter and the search field's arrows walk the
    // narrowed rows, and Enter opens the walked row.

    query: string = "",

    search(t: string) {
        query = t
        const t0 = trkNow()
        afterSettle(() => { app.searchMs = Math.round((trkNow() - t0) * 10) / 10 })
        },

    stepHit(d: number) {
        const rows = (this.shown.value.rows ?? [])
        if (rows.length == 0) return
        let j = this.selected != null ? rows.indexOf(this.selected) : (d > 0 ? -1 : rows.length)
        do { j = j + d } while (j >= 0 && j < rows.length && rows[j].kind == "hdr")
        if (j < 0 || j >= rows.length) return
        this.takeSelection([rows[j]])
        this.list.showRow(j)
        this.list.activeIndex = j
        this.list.active = rows[j]
        },

    enterHit() {
        if (this.selected == null) this.stepHit(1)
        if (this.selected != null) this.openDetail()

    // ── selection — held on the App, as records ───────────────────────────
    //
    // The Table's selection is constrained to these slots, and every verb that
    // needs "what is selected" reads them here — so selection survives any

        selected = clean.length > 0 ? clean[clean.length - 1] : null

        // it, so the draft has to move with it or the open row shows another
        // issue's fields. The draft is one slot, so an in-flight edit is

    // expanded row or the editor shows one issue's fields inside another

    seedDraft() {

    openDetail() {

    draftDiffers() -> boolean {

                text = { app.query },
                onInput(t: string) { app.search(t) },
                onEnter() { app.enterHit() },
                onKeyDown(e: KeyEvent) {
                    if (e.key == "ArrowDown") app.stepHit(1)
                    else if (e.key == "ArrowUp") app.stepHit(-1)
                    }
                ],
            hitCount: Text [ y = center, fontSize = 11, wrap = false, visible = { app.query != "" },
                x = { parent.omni.width - this.width - 10 },
                textColor = { provided("theme").textFaint },
                text = { app.shownTotal + " match" + (app.shownTotal == 1 ? "" : "es") } ]
            ],

        // the scale demo: at phone widths the search field needs the room

        views: Segmented [ visible = { !app.compact },
            segMin = 62,
            value = { app.issues.total >= 1000000 ? "1M" : app.issues.total >= 100000 ? "100k" : "10k" },
            input(v: object) { app.regenerate(("" + v) == "1M" ? 1000000 : ("" + v) == "100k" ? 100000 : 10000) },
            choices = { [ ({ id: "10k", label: "10K" }), ({ id: "100k", label: "100K" }), ({ id: "1M", label: "1M" }) ] }
            ],

        // light / dark: shows the appearance in force, a press flips it; until
        // then `themeMode` stays "auto" and the OS decides

        appear: AppearanceSwitch [
            dark = { app.darkUI },
            input(v: boolean) { app.themeMode = v ? "dark" : "light" }
            ]
        ],

    // ── the toolbar: filters on the left, actions on the right ────────────

    // The tools row is two clusters, filters left and actions right, in a
    // wrapping flow: the filters take what the actions leave, and when the two
    // would collide the actions drop to a second row of their own. That is a
    // measurement, not a breakpoint — both groups size to their own text, so a
    // long assignee name or a wider locale moves the meeting point without
    // moving the window — and the flow measures it.

    tools: View [ width = 100%, padding = [13, 24, 13, 24],
        fill = { provided("theme").background }, stroke = { [null, null, stroke(1, provided("theme").line), null] },
        layout: WrappingLayout [ justify = end, align = center, spacing = 16, rowSpacing = 12 ],

        // the filters take the room their row leaves — pushing the actions to
        // its right end — and no more than the row has: past that the strip
        // keeps every filter reachable by scrolling sideways (the phone
        // chip-row idiom) instead of spilling off-screen

        chips: View [ height = 28, flexes = true,
            scrolls = x, clip = true,
            layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = x, spacing = 8 ],
            byStatus: View [ datapath = { app.issues.byStatus.value }, padding = [0, 14, 0, 0],
                layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = x, spacing = 8 ],
                Chip [ datapath = :rows[], value = :status, count = :n, on = { app.fStatus == :status } ]
                ],
            assigneeBtn: DropButton [ on = { app.fAssignee != "" },
                label = { app.fAssignee != "" ? "@" + app.fAssignee : "Assignee" },
                menu = { app.assigneeMenu } ],
            labelBtn: DropButton [ on = { app.fLabel != "" },
                label = { app.fLabel != "" ? app.fLabel : "Label" },
                menu = { app.labelMenu } ]
            ],

        // the actions sit at the right end of their row: beside the filters,
        // or on a row of their own (the flow justifies it to the end)

        acts: View [ height = 30,
            layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = x, spacing = 16, align = center ],
            groupCheck: Checkbox [ height = 24, size = 15, fontSize = 12.5,
                label = "Grouped",
                textColor = { provided("theme").textMuted },
                checked = { app.groupBy == "status" },
                input(v: object) { app.groupBy = v ? "status" : "none" }
                ],
            sorting: View [
                layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = x, spacing = 4, align = center ],
                sortBtn: DropButton [ menu = { app.sortMenu },
                    label = { "Sort: " + app.sortOn.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + app.sortOn.slice(1) } ],
                dirBtn: Control [ height = 28, width = 28, cornerRadius = 8, tooltipLabel = "Toggle sort direction",
                    fill = { hovered || pressed ? provided("theme").control : null },
                    t: ArrowIcon [ iconSize = 13, ink = { provided("theme").textMuted },
                        x = center, y = center,
                        dir = { app.sortDir == "desc" ? "down" : "up" } ],
                    press() { app.toggleSortDir() }
                    ]
                ],
            newBtn: Button [ height = 30, fontSize = 12.5, primary = true, label = "New issue",
                onClick() { app.newIssue() }
                ]
            ]
        ],

    // which issue is open in place (0 = none): it edits where it lives, and
    // its row springs open around the editor

    expandedId: number = { app.editing && !app.creating && app.selCount == 1 && app.selected != null ? app.selected.id : 0 },

    // ── the body — the issues and the rail, in what the bar, the toolbar
    //    and the footer leave ──────────────────────────────────────────────

    body: View [ width = 100%, flexes = true,
        layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = x ],

        // the main column: the new-issue form while one is being written,
        // then the list, which takes the rest; the empty state and the bulk
        // bar float over it

        main: View [ height = 100%, flexes = true,
            layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = y ],

            creator: View [ visible = { app.creating }, width = 100%, padding = [8, 24, 8, 24],
                sheet: View [ width = 100%, height = 340, clip = true,
                    fill = { provided("theme").surface }, cornerRadius = 10,
                    stroke = { stroke(1, provided("theme").line) },
                    shadow = { shadow(0, 4, 16, 0x00000018) },
                    card: EditorCard [ width = 100% ]
                    ]
                ],

            // The list: rows over the projection, `virtualize = true` on the row.
            // Only the rows near the viewport are built, and the list measures
            // them as they grow and shrink (one springing open into the editor
            // included), with nothing more said here. It takes the column's
            // rest, up to a reading width.

            list: Table [ width = { Math.min(parent.width, 1460) }, flexes = true,
                datapath = { app.shown.value },
                selects = "multi",
                selected = { app.selected },
                selection = { app.selection },
                input(sel: array) { app.takeSelection(sel) },
                deleteRequested() { app.deleteSelection() },
                activateRequested() { app.openDetail() },
                ListRow [ datapath = :rows[], virtualize = true,
                    classFor = { :kind == "hdr" ? GroupRow : IssueRow } ]
                ],

            // the empty state says why it is empty — an overlay, centred on the list

            empty: View [ visible = { app.ready && app.shownTotal == 0 }, width = 280, ignoreLayout = true,
                x = { (parent.list.width - this.width) / 2 },
                pop: number = 0,
                Spring [ attribute = pop, to = { app.ready && app.shownTotal == 0 ? 1 : 0 }, stiffness = 220, damping = 26 ],
                opacity = { this.pop },
                y = { 120 + (1 - this.pop) * 14 },
                layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = y, spacing = 12 ],
                ring: View [ x = center, width = 36, height = 36, cornerRadius = 18,
                    stroke = { stroke(2, provided("theme").line) },
                    g: Text [ x = 0, y = center, width = 36, textAlign = center, fontSize = 15, textColor = { provided("theme").textFaint }, text = "?" ]
                    ],
                cap: Text [ width = 280, textAlign = center, fontSize = 14.5, fontWeight = semibold,
                    text = { app.issues.total == 0 ? "No issues yet" : "No issues match" } ],
                sub: Text [ width = 280, textAlign = center, fontSize = 12.5, textColor = { provided("theme").textMuted },
                    text = { app.issues.total == 0
                        ? "Create the first one — New issue is waiting."
                        : "Try a different search, or clear the filters." } ],
                clear: Button [ x = center, height = 30, fontSize = 12.5, label = "Clear all",
                    visible = { app.issues.total > 0 },
                    onClick() { app.clearAll() }
                    ]
                ],

            bulk: View [ height = 44, cornerRadius = 12, ignoreLayout = true,
                visible = { app.selCount > 1 || this.lift > 0.02 },

                // the bar inverts to the tooltip surface, with the bulk inks on it

                lift: number = 0,
                Spring [ attribute = lift, to = { app.selCount > 1 ? 1 : 0 }, stiffness = 260, damping = 26 ],
                opacity = { lift },
                padding = [8, 16, 8, 16],
                x = { (parent.list.width - this.width) / 2 },
                y = { parent.height - 60 + (1 - this.lift) * 20 },
                fill = { provided("theme").tooltipFill },
                shadow = { shadow(0, 8, 28, 0x00000050) },
                row: View [ height = 28,
                    layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = x, spacing = 14 ],
                    cnt: View [ height = 28,
                        layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = x, spacing = 6 ],
                        t: Roll [ y = center, fontSize = 13, fontWeight = semibold,
                            textColor = { provided("theme").tooltipTextColor }, n = { app.selCount } ],
                        l: Text [ y = center, fontSize = 13, wrap = false,
                            textColor = { provided("theme").tooltipTextColor }, text = "selected" ]
                        ],
                    div1: View [ width = 1, height = 20, y = 4, fill = { provided("theme").bulkLine } ],
                    act: Control [ height = 28, cornerRadius = 7, padding = [0, 10, 0, 10],
                        fill = { hovered ? provided("theme").bulkHover : null },
                        t: Text [ y = center, fontSize = 12.5, wrap = false,
                            textColor = { provided("theme").tooltipTextColor }, text = "Set status ▾" ],
                        menu = { app.bulkMenu }
                        ],
                    del: Control [ height = 28, cornerRadius = 7, padding = [0, 10, 0, 10],
                        fill = { hovered || pressed ? provided("theme").danger : null },
                        t: TextLabel [ fontSize = 12.5, fontWeight = semibold, wrap = false,
                            textColor = { this.parent.hovered || this.parent.pressed ? provided("theme").onFill : provided("theme").bulkDanger }, text = "Delete…" ],
                        press() { app.deleteSelection() }
                        ],
                    div2: View [ width = 1, height = 20, y = 4, fill = { provided("theme").bulkLine } ],
                    clr: Control [ height = 28, cornerRadius = 7, width = 28,
                        fill = { hovered ? provided("theme").bulkHover : null },
                        t: Text [ x = 0, y = center, width = 28, textAlign = center, fontSize = 13,
                            textColor = { provided("theme").tooltipTextColor }, text = "×" ],
                        press() { app.takeSelection(null) }
                        ]
                    ]
                ]
            ],

        // ── the rail: an instrument, not a sidebar. Every number is derived
        //    from the records, and every row is also a filter. ──────────────

        rail: View [ visible = { app.railOn }, width = { app.railW }, height = 100%, clip = true, scrolls = y,
            padding = 20, stroke = { [null, null, null, stroke(1, provided("theme").line)] },

            col: View [ width = 100%,
                layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = y, spacing = 22 ],

                hero: View [ width = 100%, height = 66,
                    n: Roll [ x = 0, y = 0, fontSize = 38, fontWeight = bold, letterSpacing = -1,
                        textFill = { gradient("90deg", provided("theme").accent, provided("theme").brandTeal) },
                        n = { app.shownTotal } ],
                    cap: Text [ x = 2, y = 48, fontSize = 11.5, wrap = false, textColor = { provided("theme").textFaint },
                        text = { app.shownTotal == app.issues.total
                            ? "issues · nothing filtered out"
                            : "matching · of " + app.issues.total.toLocaleString() + " issues" } ]
                    ],

                byStatus: View [ width = 100%,
                    layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = y, spacing = 10 ],
                    cap: RailCaption [ text = "BY STATUS" ],

                    // one band, each status's share of it in its color

                    dist: View [ width = 100%, height = 6, cornerRadius = 3, clip = true,
                        datapath = { app.issues.byStatus.value },
                        layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = x ],
                        View [ datapath = :rows[], height = 6, fill = { app.statusColor(:status) },
                            width = { parent.width * :n / Math.max(1, app.issues.total) } ]
                        ],
                    rows: View [ width = 100%, datapath = { app.issues.byStatus.value },
                        layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = y, spacing = 2 ],
                        RailStat [ datapath = :rows[], facet = "status", value = :status, cap = { app.issues.statusLabel(:status) },
                            n = :n, peak = { app.issues.total }, tint = { app.statusColor(:status) },
                            on = { app.fStatus == :status },
                            ic: StatusIcon [ x = 8, y = 8, s = :status ]
                            ]
                        ]
                    ],

                work: View [ width = 100%,
                    layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = y, spacing = 10 ],
                    cap: RailCaption [ text = "WORKLOAD · OPEN WORK" ],
                    rows: View [ width = 100%, datapath = { app.issues.workload.value },
                        layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = y, spacing = 2 ],
                        RailStat [ datapath = :rows[], facet = "assignee", value = :name,
                            cap = { :name == "" ? "Unassigned" : :name },
                            n = :n, peak = :peak,
                            tint = { :name == "" ? 0 : app.hueOf(:name) },
                            on = { app.fAssignee != "" && app.fAssignee == :name },
                            av: Avatar [ x = 4, y = 4, width = 20, height = 20, cornerRadius = 10, name = :name ]
                            ]
                        ]
                    ],

                closed14: View [ width = 100%, datapath = { app.issues.closedByDay.value },
                    layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = y, spacing = 10 ],
                    cap: RailCaption [ text = "CLOSED · LAST 14 DAYS" ],

                    // fourteen bars sharing the width equally, each as tall as its
                    // day's count against the busiest day

                    bars: View [ width = 100%, height = 40,
                        peak: number = { Math.max(1, :peak) },
                        layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = x, spacing = 3 ],
                        View [ datapath = :days[], flexes = true, cornerRadius = 1.5,
                            height = { Math.max(2, 38 * :@ / parent.peak) },
                            y = { 40 - this.height },
                            fill = { app.statusColor("closed") } ]
                        ]
                    ],

                perf: View [ width = 100%,
                    layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = y, spacing = 8 ],
                    cap: RailCaption [ text = "PERFORMANCE" ],
                    PerfLine [ what = "Initial load", ms = { app.loadMs } ],
                    PerfLine [ what = "Ingest", ms = { app.ingestMs } ],
                    PerfLine [ what = "Last search", ms = { app.searchMs }, visible = { app.query != "" } ]
                    ],

                keys: View [ width = 100%, padding = [0, 0, 8, 0],
                    layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = y, spacing = 6 ],
                    cap: RailCaption [ text = "KEYBOARD" ],
                    KeyHint [ shortcut = "⌘K", what = "Search" ],
                    KeyHint [ shortcut = "↵", what = "Open selected row" ],
                    KeyHint [ shortcut = "⌫", what = "Delete selection" ],
                    KeyHint [ shortcut = "esc", what = "Close · clear" ]
                    ]
                ]
            ]
        ],

    // ── the footer: the quiet ledger line, how many and how many shown ─────

    foot: View [ width = 100%, height = 32, padding = [0, 16, 0, 24],
        fill = { provided("theme").surface }, stroke = { [stroke(1, provided("theme").line), null, null, null] },
        stats: Text [ y = center, fontSize = 11.5, wrap = false, textColor = { provided("theme").textFaint },
            text = { app.issues.total.toLocaleString() + " issues   ·   " + app.shownTotal.toLocaleString() + " shown" } ],
        perf: Text [ y = center, fontSize = 10.5, wrap = false, visible = { app.ready && !app.railOn },
            x = end,
            textColor = { provided("theme").textFaint },
            text = { "load " + app.loadMs + " ms · ingest " + app.ingestMs + " ms" } ]
        ],

    toast: Toast [ ignoreLayout = true, x = center,
        y = { app.height - 84 + (1 - this.lift) * 20 } ],

    // the entry screen: honest states for the one fetch

    entry: View [ visible = { !app.ready }, ignoreLayout = true, x = 0, y = 0, width = { app.width }, height = { app.height },
        fill = { provided("theme").background },
        col: View [ x = center, y = { app.height * 0.38 }, width = 220,
            layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = y, spacing = 10 ],
            Text [ fontSize = 22, fontWeight = semibold, textAlign = center, width = 220,
                textFill = { gradient("90deg", provided("theme").accent, provided("theme").brandTeal) }, text = "Tracker" ],
            Text [ fontSize = 12.5, textAlign = center, width = 220, textColor = { provided("theme").textMuted },
                text = { app.issues.failed ? "Could not load issues.json" : "Loading issues…" } ]
            ]
        ]
    ]
